name: Table
import: import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/table';
whenToUse: Static tabular data with a few rows and no sorting, paging or selection: a price breakdown, DNS records, a spec sheet.
Building something custom where DataTable doesn’t fit.

whenNotToUse.text: Label / value pairs about one object
Laying out a form or a page
Rows with one main item and an action

anatomy.description: scrolls horizontally on a wide screen; with `containerLabel` it becomes a named region.

below 640px rows stack into items (`mobileLayout="stack"`, default; labels from the headers, `label` / `stackAction` on a cell). A comparison pages its columns (`paged`); `scroll` keeps the table, `stickyFirstColumn` freezes the first column.
what the table shows; can be sr-only.
column names on a subtle surface.
numbers right-aligned with `text-right tabular-nums` on head and cell.

do.caption: Numbers right-aligned, the table has a caption.
do.example: Disk usage by siteSiteDisk{ROWS.map(([s, d]) => {s}{d})}

dont.caption: Left-aligned numbers are hard to compare by magnitude.

a11y: Real table markup: header cells are announced with every cell.
Name the table — a `TableCaption` (visible or sr-only) or `containerLabel`.
A scrolling table must be reachable by keyboard; the named container is a region screen-reader users can jump to.
Don’t make a row clickable by itself — use DataTable’s row link, which is a real link.

props.name: columnsPerPage
props.description: `mobileLayout="paged"`: how many columns besides the first show at a time.

props.name: containerLabel
props.description:
Optional accessible name for the scroll container. When set, the
container becomes a `role="region"` landmark with this label. The
container is always keyboard-focusable (`tabIndex={0}`) so a
keyboard/switch user can scroll a table wider than the viewport —
WCAG 2.1.1 / axe's scrollable-region-focusable. Previously this
container had no tab stop at all: a table too wide for its box was
only scrollable by mouse drag or trackpad.

props.name: mobileLayout
props.description: How the table fits a phone (below 640px): `stack` rows into label/value items (default), show the columns in `paged` groups, or `scroll` sideways.

props.name: stickyFirstColumn
props.description: Keep the first column in place while the table scrolls sideways.

props.name: label
props.description: Label beside the value when the Table stacks on a phone. Defaults to the column header's text; `false` makes the cell run full width (another title line).

props.name: stackAction
props.description: In a stacked Table, pin this cell (a row menu, a remove button) to the item's top end.
